notes.title: Demo Version 0.966
notes.content: [h2]Major Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Emote selection added to the appearance menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Color selection added to the appearance menu.[/p][/*][*][p]New King of the Hill Map.[/p][/*][*][p]Players disconnecting or leaving a match will be replaced with bots.[/p][/*][*][p]New Powerup: C4.[/p][/*][*][p]Whack-A-Crate now has golden and explosive crates to watch out for.[/p][/*][*][p]Added advanced match settings including: Bot difficulty, hit power, movement speed, disable jump.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Minor Fixes and Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Improved bot behaviour.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players could be eliminated twice in a row.[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra VFX to epic and legendary hats.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved player name rendering.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new emotes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where highlighted important players would not show while in rock form.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where powerups would not be removed on elimination.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved host start procedure.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Playtest Live Now
notes.content:
We have finally reached a point where we would love feedback on what we have so far! ːsteamhappyː Following this, our playtest is now available on Steam. Grab your party crew and head over to our store page to sign up ːsteamhappyː

We will continue to work on new content to show you all and fix those nasty bugs that are found. Thanks so much for early interest in our maniacal golf brawler!

If you would like to chat with us directly, join us in the official [b]Super Serious Golf [url=https://discord.com/invite/T2ncbRAw3T]Discord[/url][/b]:

notes.title: Coming November 2025 at $4.99
notes.content:
[h2]Releasing November 2025[/h2]

We are hard at work to launch Super Serious Golf [b]November this year[/b]! ːsteamhappyː We have a massive amount of content, cosmetics and game modes lined up nearly ready to go.

We will also be making an appearance in the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] at some point before launch so stay tuned!

[h2]Pricing and Updates[/h2]

Super Serious Golf will be priced at [b]$4.99[/b] on launch with a 10% launch discount, so hop with the whole crew for a chaotic time ːsteamsaltyː and we'll be right at work on a range of updates post launch.
